headline: Sales dip, impairment drives GAAP loss; guidance rises
summary_short: Q2 GAAP EPS swung to -$0.19 (from $0.83 a year ago) on a $228.7M non-cash Fiberon impairment, while EPS before charges/gains rose to $1.35 (+35.0% y/y) as revenue fell 4.1% y/y to $1,153.9M.
summary_long: GAAP operating income swung to a $9.0M loss (from $171.6M) and diluted EPS to -$0.19 (from $0.83), driven almost entirely by a $228.7M non-cash asset impairment on the Fiberon business within Outdoors, which management placed under strategic review in May 2026, plus $43.6M of governance-advisory and leadership-transition costs. Excluding charges and a $0.52 net tariff-refund benefit, EPS before charges/gains was $1.35, up 35.0% y/y. Revenue fell 4.1% y/y to $1,153.9M as Water (-6.5%) and Outdoors (-3.8%) declined while Security grew 3.8%. Fortune Brands raised FY2026 EPS-before-charges guidance to $3.22-$3.52 (from $3.00-$3.30) on the tariff-refund benefit and narrowed operating-margin guidance to 14.0%-15.0%. Cash fell to $209.7M; free cash flow was $179.3M.
